properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. From the hxm_program hub's 2026-09-28 field report (art:hxm-program-feedback-2026-09-28), O-23, in the reporter's words: "Intent-aware rule enforcement. Let an enforced rule declare what it guards as an *action* (open a session to host X, send a Channel Access request), not a word list. Or at minimum, exempt file writes and local reads whose paths are all local."

AN EARLIER SIGHTING FROM THE SAME HUB, 2026-09-08, never recorded: "a DesignRule about agent conduct (no remote sessions on beamline hosts) has no Component to be GOVERNED_BY; the skill says leave it unbound, which is honest, but a 'governs the agent itself' target would make such rules findable by topic."

WHAT THE ROOT-CAUSE PASS FOUND (fact:root-cause-the-conduct-rule-was-enforced-by-the-projects-own-text-matching-hook-and-reflow2-cannot-say-what-a-rule-guards-2026-09-28): the matcher that blocked local work is the project's own harness hook, textual by design, whose header records the false positive as accepted ("Strict beats clever"). reflow2 ships no such hook. What reflow2 lacks is any way for a DesignRule to say what action it guards or where it is enforced: `enforced` means "stops the build", and `steps` can name only reflow2's own served skills and tools. Run on eight synthetic commands, the hook refused prose and exclusions, and let through one remote-desktop client that is not on its list.

OPTIONS, NONE CHOSEN:
(a) THE RULE DECLARES WHAT IT GUARDS. A structured field on DesignRule, such as an action kind (open a remote session, write to a control system) and a target pattern, that a project's own hook reads from the export. The hook's list is then generated from the design, not kept by hand.
(b) reflow2 SHIPS AN OPTIONAL HOOK ADAPTER, like the loop-nudge adapters, that reads enforced rules' declared actions and decides per tool call.
(c) THE RULE RECORDS ITS CHECK'S SCOPE. Known false positives and known misses sit on the rule or on its Verification, and the governance-proposal skill asks for both when a rule is enforced outside the build. An agent reading the rule then learns "write prose through the editor tool" before the retry, not after.
(d) THE REPORTER'S MINIMUM: exempt file writes and local reads whose paths are all local. A matcher change in the project's own hook; nothing for reflow2.
(e) NOTHING: "strict beats clever" was the owner's knowing choice for a safety rule.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS, RECORDED BESIDE IT:
· The harness hands a hook the command TEXT and nothing else. Inferring a shell command's intent (aliases, variables, a script that calls ssh) is not solvable in general. (a) moves the word list into the design; it does not make the matcher intent-aware.
· For a safety rule the two failure directions are unequal: a false positive costs a retry, and a false negative can put the owner in trouble on a production host. The measurement found a false negative, which argues that the list's completeness matters more than its precision.
· (b) is harness-specific. reflow2 skipped a harness hook for root-cause on 2026-09-06 because it "reaches ... one harness only" (dec:idea-how-does-root-cause-become-automatic-rule-hook-detector-or-composition), and rule:mcp-and-the-graph-are-the-only-common-ground holds reflow2 to what any MCP client can use.
· (d) belongs to the project, not to reflow2.
· FEWER THINGS (dec:idea-reflow2-does-fewer-things-and-does-them-really-well): (a) and (b) move reflow2 toward runtime policy enforcement, a new job. (c) only records what a rule's check does and does not catch.
· Size, as information: (a) small in reflow2 (a schema field plus skill text), with the project's hook to change; (b) medium to large, and once per harness; (c) small; (d) small, project-side; (e) none.
properties.name: OPEN — should an enforced rule be able to declare WHAT ACTION it guards and where it is enforced (the agent's own tool call, not only the build), so a project's guard matches the declared action instead of a hand-kept word list, and the rule's known false positives are in the design?
properties.rationale: Captured under the brainstorm skill (fetched fresh) during the triage of art:hxm-program-feedback-2026-09-28. Searched first ("enforced rule declares the action it guards", "agent conduct rule", "where a rule is enforced"): the nearest are the 09-18 question of a rule reaching a moment that is not a reflow2 step and the 08-31 question of where a developer-machine rule lives, both of which this answers from another side.
